messages.en: Are you sleeping..?
It's time for you to go to work~
There was an error, so I had a lot I wanted to say but couldn'tㅓ

messages.ko: 일단 tma에서 상받게 해줘서 너무 고맙다는 말 하고싶었어!! 그런 큰무대에서 무대를 하고 상을 받는다는게 정말 값진 경험인데 정말 행복했어 덕분에 우리가 해보는것들이 많은것같아서 항상 너무 고맙다… 트리플에스가 짧다면 짧고 길다면 긴 시간속에서 많은 성장을 하게 도와줘서 고마워 앞으로의 시간들도 열심히 보답할게!!
messages.en: First of all, I wanted to say thank you so much for letting me receive an award at TMA!! Performing on such a big stage and receiving an award is such a valuable experience, and I was really happy. I feel like we're able to experience so many things thanks to you, so I'm always so grateful… Thank you for helping tripleS grow so much over what is a short time if it's short and a long time if it's long. I'll work hard to repay you in the time ahead too!!

messages.ko: 요즘 항상 생각하거든 내가 뭘 할 수 있을까 뭘 해줄 수 있을까 뭘 보여줄 수 있을까 이런생각
messages.en: I've been thinking about this a lot lately, like what can I do, what can I do for you, what can I show you.

messages.ko: 결론은 후회없게 모든걸 Y/n한테 쏟아 부어야겠다 생각했어
messages.en: In the end, I thought I should pour everything I have into Y/n so that I won't have any regrets.
Just like Y/n does for me.

messages.ko: 부족한게 여전히 많다는점에선 내가 성장하겠다 보여줘야겠다 했던 다짐에 비해 너무 부실했던거같아서 너무 미안해
messages.en: I'm so sorry because when it comes to how much I still lack, I feel like I was too lacking compared to the resolve I had to show you that I would grow.

messages.ko: 이제 곧 다가올 많은 활동들과 무대들에서 내 진심을 보여주고싶다는 생각이 드네
messages.en: I feel like I want to show you my sincerity through all the activities and stages that are coming up soon.

messages.ko: Y/n가 나한테 거는 기대치가 어떻든 그 이상을 보여주고싶은게 내 마음인데
messages.en: No matter what expectations Y/n has for me, my heart is to show you even more than that.
Just keep loving me from now on too.
I guess I said it indirectly.
And tripleS too!

messages.ko: 갑자기 느낀 생각들이라기 보단 시상식소감과함께 전하고 싶었어ㅓ
messages.en: Rather than these being thoughts I suddenly had, I wanted to share them along with my award acceptance speechㅓ
And I went to an event yesterday for the first time in a while,
and I feel like I realized it once again.
I'm happiest when I'm on stage,

messages.ko: 오랜 시간이 지난다 해도 무대에 섰던 나는 절대 못잊을것같아
messages.en: and even after a long time passes, I don't think I'll ever be able to forget the me who stood on stage.
I'm so, so grateful.
Because Y/n supports me by my side.
It's an emotional time this early in the morning,

messages.ko: 나에겐 아침이 아니라 아무렇지 않다 ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋ키키킼
messages.en: but for me, it's not morning, so I don't mind ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋ키키킼
I didn't sleep, I'm at the salonㅑ
Actually, I could've slept for about an hour,
but I got so immersed watching science YouTube that I couldn't sleep…
You've been up all night, so you're still in the late-night mood.
Right, it's still dawn for me.

messages.ko: 어제 무대하고 내려와서 뭔가 싱숭생숭한거야 내 기분이
messages.en: After coming off the stage yesterday, I felt kind of unsettled.
I was just feeling a lot of different emotions,
so I tried to put them into words.
ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㅋㅋ
And at TMA,
How was my hair?
It was a big challenge..
At the awards ceremony,
I played a lot of Halli Galli,
and that helped me get rid of my swelling.
If I play Halli Galli with Y/n,
I'll run over and hit the bell for you,
and give it all to Y/n.
I heard Hayeon got first place during practice, but what place did you get in the actual game???
I was in first place the whole time.
You believe me, right?
ㅋ
There are five fruits!!
I'll win it all for you.
It must be tiring to work from the morning and then go to school,
so stay strong.

messages.ko: 스케줄 시작하면 못올까봐 사실 빨리 온건데
messages.en: I actually came early because I was worried I wouldn't be able to come once my schedule started,
I'll contact you again if I can during the break.
I miss you~
Stay strong while thinking of me,
and don't catch a cold.
I'm having a runny-nose party.
Ah, I won't say things like that.
Make sure you eat well~~~
Haranghae😘❤️❤️
